note: In-town campground one block north of Wall Drug at the north edge of Wall, the gateway town for Badlands NP and Buffalo Gap National Grassland. RV sites in rows A-G with 30/20 or 50/30/20 amp; many add sewer and/or cable; sites 9-10B are the ones recommended for high-profile big rigs. Separate tent sites (RVs not allowed on them). Dog park; extra vehicles go in a free overflow lot. --Claude
